description: Stopped prompting and read the play aloud.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Walked the crosses and did not speak.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Looked at the sun, said the Rose has Hercules again, and broke them at eleven.
name: John Heminges

description: Stood in a doublet that would fit a rake, and gave the unkind thanks.
name: John Sincler

description: Dried four times in the same place and apologised to Garnish, Heminges, Pope, and William.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Stood padded to a barrel, and said Sincler needs none.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Spoke the eight lines and refused to call it a triumph.
name: William Shakespeare
